name: Social Index
description:
Since 2013, Social Index has been the industry standard for measuring earned media value and campaign ROI. Over 3,000 companies rely on the Index, along with platforms like Brandwatch, Sprout Social, and Julius, to validate the true value of a social marketing investment.

Measure the earned media value and ROI of influencer, content marketing, PR, organic, and paid social campaigns. Query daily EMV rates across 15 social platforms, 9 industry verticals, and key NA, EMEA, and APAC markets, with 19+ months of historical lookback. Retrieve the full rate card for any segment, pull the latest value for a given metric and date range, and compute the Earned Media Value of specific Instagram or TikTok posts directly from their URLs. The assistant can list every valid region, vertical, platform, and metric, so queries resolve against real segments.

Social Index MCP access is included with Enterprise API plans.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Social Index to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Social Index to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.earnedmediavalues.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Social Index MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Social Index provides these MCP tools: calculate_urls_emv, emv_healthcheck, get_emv_data, get_emv_last_value, get_emv_rates, and list_emv_metric_options.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Social Index?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Social Index in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does Social Index MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Social Index requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Social Index is developed by Ayzenberg Group. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
